# awscc_appfabric_ingestion_destination (Resource)

Creates an ingestion destination, which specifies how an application's ingested data is processed by Amazon Web Services AppFabric and where it's delivered.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_bundle_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the app bundle.
- `destination_configuration` (Attributes) Contains information about the destination of ingested data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_configuration))
- `ingestion_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the ingestion.
- `processing_configuration` (Attributes) Contains information about how ingested data is processed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--processing_configuration))

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) A map of the key-value pairs of the tag or tags to assign to the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the ingestion destination.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp of when the ingestion destination was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The state of the ingestion destination.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp of when the ingestion destination was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appfabric_ingestion_destination.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the ingestion destination

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appfabric_ingestion_destination.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_appfabric_ingestion_destination.example "arn"
```
